scope: Targeted validation of permutation-query tightness and fixed-header NPCR calibration.

b13_query_tightness.probe_encoding: little-endian base-256 digits of the input byte-position index

b23_npcr_power.alternative_model: The 32 fixed prefix coordinates agree deterministically; the remaining AES-GCM suffix-coordinate pairs follow the independent ideal-byte model.
b23_npcr_power.multiplicity_calibration: Exact first-step Holm familywise power under independent registered tests. Any Holm rejection occurs iff at least one p-value is at most alpha/m.
b23_npcr_power.observed_comparison: Compare model probabilities with an independently regenerated B23 family. Compatibility is a calibration result and not a primitive-security test.
